## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy`, and `cargo test` pass (Rust)
- [ ] `npm run build` / `tsc` pass (desktop UI)
- [ ] User-facing strings go through i18n (`t(...)`), with keys added to both
      `en` and `pt-BR` locale files
- [ ] Comments and identifiers are in English
- [ ] I updated docs / CHANGELOG if the change is user-visible
